595K likes, 3,244 comments - tanyakhanijow on March 14, 2024: "Ladakh itinerary for the summer! 🫶 Btw, this was originally designed by @eforeshaan 🙈

Here’s a little day wise detail: 

Day 1-2 Leh 
Day 3 - Drive to Karzok
Day 4-5 Spend time around Karzok and acclimatise 
Day 6-7 Hanle 
Day 8-10 Merak Village 
Day 11-12 Nubra 
Day 13-15 Turtuk 
Day 16-19 Kargil and Suru Valley 

To cut down on days, you can skip going to places that don’t interest you as much or just follow the circuit route! 

Video created on @mapcreator_io".

503K likes, 600 comments - tanyakhanijow on March 12, 2025: "Watch the entire vlog on YouTube!

Throwback to my favourite experience and reel from past year because the full fledged vlog from this day is now live on my YouTube channel. It is not just about this day but also randomly seeing northern lights on a grocery store run, and a hike in between canyons to see frozen waterfalls! 

If you’re having your chai or coffee, dinner or breakfast, it is a perfect 20 minute watch which I promise will make you feel some emotions! And you’ll fall in love with the cold. 

Take a moment and give it a watch. ❤️😘

In collaboration with @getyourguide".

posts.meta_description:
6,025 likes, 48 comments - tanyakhanijow on September 22, 2026: "AI is cute, but this end result is so charming! 

So we took this trend a step forward to showcase how to actually film it. You’ll need a phone and a phone gimbal. Set it to 

✏️ 0.5x lens 
✏️ 4K 60 fps 
✏️ Walk around your subject at a normal pace and 
✏️ Pause for 2s at each unique position 
✏️ Subject has to keep staring at the camera
✏️ In editing, place cuts between the 2s pauses and speed up the footage in those segments to get the final result! 

And for more inspiration and learning from @tanyakhanijow, join our next live workshop on 26th Sept 2026, 10 AM. 

Link is in Bio".

8,636 likes, 123 comments - tanyakhanijow on September 19, 2026: "Most insane off-roading experience in Sikkim!

This might just be one of the bumpiest roads I’ve ever taken.
There were stretches where I genuinely wondered if we were still going the right way. And imagine, this is how the locals travel every time they need access to hospitals, doctors, services. Even construction material for homes is transported through these 😳

And after all of that, we finally reached this incredibly remote corner of Sikkim and suddenly, the entire journey felt worth it.

Want to see where this road took me? Check out my latest YouTube video.".

posts.meta_description:
28K likes, 793 comments - tanyakhanijow on September 17, 2026: "It is strange how even work desks can hold so many memories. 
Of a version of you that you vaguely remember but deeply cherish ♥️

I’m so grateful to younger Tanya for having the courage and determination to do this repeatedly, over and over again.

I’ve worked from so many corners, homes and desks over the years. Some were proper setups, some were very much ‘make it work’ situations.

But looking back I’ve realised that the setup was never the important part. It was the will power, the ideas, the consistency. And honestly, just starting somewhere

If you’ve been thinking about starting your own creator journey,  learn from someone who’s seen it all, tested it all, been doing it consistently for years! And can help you with real evidence to make your journey smooth 

So I’m hosting the next @juststartschool workshop live on 26th September 2026 at 10 AM! 

I’ll talk about finding content styles, ideation, shooting, editing, storytelling and actually getting started as a creator.

Sign up link is in my bio!".

posts.meta_description:
9,822 likes, 42 comments - tanyakhanijow on September 16, 2026: "Eating with locals is fun
But cooking with them is next level!

While exploring Sikkim, I got to learn how to make a local buckwheat pancake/ chilla with someone who’s perfected local looking with foraged veggies and homegrown ingredients. And honestly, the cooking, the smell, the flavours and little laughs along the way were just as memorable as the food itself.

Sometimes you can experience the place better when you seek an offbeat adventure and cook with the local ingredients instead of just tasting the food served to you.

Check out more from my time in Sikkim in my latest YouTube video.".
